posts.title_en: +20 enhancement is really awful
posts.summary_en: Screenshots of a weapon (sword) plate +19→+20 attempt: rates 0.10% great success / 2.00% success / 87.90% maintain / 0.00% drop (drop protection on) / 10.00% destroy; 25 Chocosteel + 4 Syrup Metal per press; +20 raises main-option amplification +177%→+200% and sub-option +130%→+200%. The poster spent about 1,300 Chocosteel over 52 presses (expected value they cite: 44) and the plate was destroyed to +17 for −74M 668K power. Commenters: going all +18 is cheaper than one +20; stopping resets accumulated stacks.

datapoints.before: sword plate +19 (main option amp +177.00%, sub option amp +130.00%)
datapoints.cost: 25 초코강 + 4 쇳물 per press with 하락 방지 checked
datapoints.note: rates on screen: 대성공 0.10%, 성공 2.00%, 유지 87.90%, 하락 0.00%, 박살 10.00%

datapoints.before: sword plate +19: attack +9,933, crit rate +16.81%, skill amp +9.06% (equipped gear stats)
datapoints.after: destroyed to +17: attack +8,642, crit rate 16.81%, skill amp 9.06%
datapoints.cost: about 1,300 초코강 over 52 presses; restore costs 50 쇳물
datapoints.note: power popup on destruction: 전투력 -74M 668K (kind not stated); 1300 and 52 as stated by the poster, expected value 44 presses as the poster recalls

advice.text: (comment) Taking every slot to +18 is cheaper than sending one to +20.
(comment) Stopping resets the built-up stacks, so pick a day and keep pressing.

quotes.en: 1,300 Chocosteel, that's 52 presses.
The expected value was 44 presses.

posts.title_en: Crumble Dungeon 1.09T, for the record
posts.summary_en: Crumble Dungeon guide at 1,098,710,910,175 (rank 3rd, previous best 989.24G; power on screen 17G 404M 154K). Set the gear preset, power and attack order before level tuning; level so the team stays within the top 40 power (2M above the 41st); attack order 우유, 피겨 / 시커, 전갈, 치케 (5 dealers, Chardonnay is a guaranteed buff); supports except Chardonnay as low as possible. Perk: 열정페이 5사격. Gear: Conquest set (top-left flat ATK + skill amp, bottom-left HP + dmg reduction, top-right skill amp + skill acc, bottom-right dmg reduction + skill acc); plates sword +17, bow and staff +16, rest +15; breakthrough 1039. Runes: 우유 and 호밀 (Rye) attack (Rye for arena), 시커 skill-acc, 샤르/피겨/치케/석류 skill amp, other dealers a mix of skill amp, crit rate, crit damage.

datapoints.account: power on screen 17G 404M 154K (kind not stated); cookies up to Lv.118
datapoints.note: Chardonnay at Lv.118 for this run

advice.text: Set the gear preset, power and attack order before tuning levels, or the dungeon order breaks.
Keep team power in the top 40; be about 2M above the 41st.
Keep other dealers 10–20K attack below 치케; supports except Chardonnay at the lowest level.
Use the Conquest gear set: top-left flat ATK + skill amp, bottom-left HP + dmg reduction, top-right skill amp + skill acc, bottom-right dmg reduction + skill acc.
우유 and 호밀 attack; 시커 skill acc; 샤르, 피겨, 치케, 석류 skill amp; other dealers mix skill amp, crit rate, crit damage.
Welfare perk: 열정페이 5사격.

damage.text: Attack order and level tuning decide the score: Chardonnay always buffs, so only 5 dealers are ordered; 우유 joins the main group around 55 s.
Switching the top-left Conquest slot to flat attack seemed better after the flat-attack discussion (poster's impression).

quotes.en: Tune levels so power ranks within the top 40 (about 2M above the 41st).

quotes.kr: 렙조절할때 장비프리셋 미리 껴놓고 투력이랑 공순서 정해놔야 크던에서 안꼬임

posts.summary_en: The poster's own gear-option layout per mode, with one correction: Arena top-left skill amp + crit damage (not crit rate), bottom-left dmg reduction + crit resist (HP if no crit resist), top-right skill acc + skill amp, bottom-right skill acc + dmg reduction; Conquest top-left skill amp + crit damage, bottom-left dmg reduction + HP, top-right skill acc + skill amp, bottom-right skill acc + dmg reduction; Stage weapon skill amp/crit rate/crit damage/accuracy, armour dmg reduction + crit resist, accessories accuracy + skill amp, bottom-right focus/crit resist/dmg reduction.

advice.text: Arena: TL skill amp + crit damage, BL dmg reduction + crit resist (else HP), TR skill acc + skill amp, BR skill acc + dmg reduction.
Conquest: TL skill amp + crit damage, BL dmg reduction + HP, TR skill acc + skill amp, BR skill acc + dmg reduction.
Stage: weapon skill amp/crit rate/crit damage/accuracy; armour dmg reduction + crit resist; accessories accuracy + skill amp; BR focus/crit resist/dmg reduction.

damage.text: Conquest gear: skill amp and crit damage top-left, skill acc and skill amp top-right (poster's understanding).
Arena gear: top-left skill amp + crit damage (comment correction), crit resist on defence slots.

quotes.en: (comment) Arena top-left: skill amp + crit damage.

posts.title_en: One-line take on every patch over two months of Crumble
posts.summary_en: Patch-by-patch recap: 1.4 started the stage nerf to the 35% tier, 1.5 put a heavy-spender wall in the normal dungeon; Chardonnay is the 1.5 cookie.

quotes.en: The stage nerf properly began the 35% tier.

posts.title_en: After brooch to +14 without metal and +15 with metal, what next?
posts.summary_en: The poster (weapon plate +20, others +15, cookies Lv.117, oven Lv.36) hit +20 at roughly the expected cost, about 1,425 Chocosteel / 400 Syrup Metal. Commenter: for Conquest, prioritise book + magic object to +20 (both crit damage); for power, two +17s.

advice.text: (comment) For Conquest, book and magic object plates to +20 first; for power, two +17s.

posts.title_en: Plates past +15: what after the weapon?

(comment) For Conquest, book and magic object.

damage.text: (comment) Book and magic object plates are the Conquest picks; armour is the power pick.

quotes.kr: 올 15강하고나서 장비 전투력보는데 갑옷이 투력 좆되더라

(comment) For Conquest they say raise the book and magic object.

posts.title_en: The item that shortens research time
posts.summary_en: Commenters agree: spend research speed-ups on Mercenary Band Lv.4, since research stones, not time, limit the Gnome lab; use them on research only to finish a 1–2 h remainder before sleep.

advice.text: (comment) Pour the speed-ups into Mercenary Band Lv.4.
(comment) Research stones can't keep up with research speed; only skip a 1–2 h remainder before sleeping.

posts.title_en: Power rose over 1G in a day
posts.summary_en: Power went from 3G just before the patch to 4G 38M 280K (account Lv.187) in a day, from Chardonnay, the level expansion and more. A commenter attributes gains to the level cap rise and pouring keys in after the normal dungeon nerf.

quotes.en: (comment) With the level cap lifted and the normal dungeon nerfed I poured in all my keys and it rose a lot.

posts.title_en: Has crit resistance become more important?
posts.summary_en: Since high crit rate triggers stronger crit tiers, the poster switched all damage-reduction options to crit resistance, keeps evasion around 1,500 and plans to swap an evasion + skill-acc piece to crit resist + skill-acc once the shield plate passes 1,500.

advice.text: Poster: replace damage reduction with crit resistance; hold evasion around 1500.

damage.text: Higher crit rate triggers stronger crit tiers, so crit resistance is favoured over damage reduction (poster's reasoning, mode inferred).

quotes.en: They say high crit rate triggers stronger crits.

quotes.en: Put 500 into the weapon and it didn't budge.
